title: Pirates of Silicon Valley "You don't get it Steve, that doesn't matter"
summary: A short scene from the film Pirates of Silicon Valley where Steve Jobs confronts Bill Gates after the Macintosh announcement over Windows copying Apple's work, and Gates replies that it doesn't matter.
why: HN quotes the scene when a better product loses to a more pragmatic or dominant competitor.

quote.text: You don't get it Steve, that doesn't matter.
